# Inference Performance and Cost Engineering

> Make a language model service meet its latency objectives at the lowest cost you can defend, with quality held in Arabic and English. SDAIA Academy course AE-401, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,112 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Model the cost first](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day1.md): Prefill, decode, cache and goodput: predict before you measure; sessions: Prefill and decode are different problems, Key-value cache arithmetic, Goodput against an objective, Curves, not single numbers; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day1.html; about 5,196 tokens
- [Day 2: Scheduling and caching in the engine](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day2.md): Three seeded faults, then the engine settings and caches that fix them; sessions: Continuous batching and admission, Long prompts slow short ones, Prefix caching starts with prompt layout, Semantic caching and wrong answers; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day2.html; about 4,563 tokens
- [Day 3: Cheaper tokens, same quality](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day3.md): Smaller numbers, smaller models, guessed tokens: each re-evaluated in two languages; sessions: Quantising weights, Cache precision buys concurrency, Speculative decoding, Distilled models and routing to them; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day3.html; about 4,282 tokens
- [Day 4: Across replicas and over the day](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day4.md): Topology, routing, scaling and the cost of a successful request; sessions: Disaggregated prefill and decode, Routing across replicas, Autoscaling and cold starts, Cost per successful request; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/day4.html; about 3,761 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/capstone.md): Twelve minutes of evidence and eight of questions, with one traffic change predicted and rerun; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/slides/capstone.html; about 870 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Operations and bytes per token](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D1_1_compute_operations_bytes.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Concurrency limit at three context lengths](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D1_2_predict_concurrency_limit.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: The baseline at three concurrency levels](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D1_3_load_baseline_three.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: A seven-point goodput curve](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D1_4_build_seven_point.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: The concurrency cap](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D2_1_vary_concurrency_cap.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Long documents and chat, chunked or not](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D2_2_mix_long_document.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Prompt layout and tenant isolation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D2_3_reorder_prompt_reuse.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Semantic cache thresholds](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D2_4_measure_hit_rate.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Two weight precisions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D3_1_compare_two_weight.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Lower cache precision](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D3_2_lower_cache_precision.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Acceptance rate at two loads](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D3_3_measure_acceptance_rate.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Route by difficulty](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D3_4_route_supplied_difficulty.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: When disaggregation pays](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D4_1_predict_when_disaggregation.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Round robin or prefix-aware](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D4_2_compare_round_robin.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Scaling over the day](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D4_3_replay_daily_pattern.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Self-hosting or a hosted API](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-401/labs/D4_4_compare_self_hosting.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
